                                      Resolution 2024-16
                        Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
                           RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT FOR
     GIRDWOOD ARTS AND RECREATION PROPOSAL CONCEPT FOR PROJECT ANCHORAGE

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors is grateful to the individuals and groups that have put the Girdwood Arts and
    Recreation proposal together and appreciates the hard work and creativity that have gone into developing this proposal for the
    community; and

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Arts and Recreation proposal concept for Project Anchorage has received support from both the Girdwood
    Housing and Economic and the Girdwood Land Use committees; and

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Arts and Recreation District is a placemaking project recognizing that art and recreation are economic
     drivers for Girdwood and the broader Anchorage community; and

   WHEREAS, the proposed project included the following elements: capital for a physical Art space, development of an RV Park with a
    bathroom, a pump track, 11 cabins and extension of utilities in the South Townsite, as well as a capital fund for additional assets and
    improvements for Girdwood Parks and Recreation projects; and

   WHEREAS, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors, Girdwood Housing and Economic Committee and Girdwood Land Use Committee
    have voted to nominate the RV park development as the top priority among the variety of projects within the Girdwood Arts and
    Recreation proposal; and

   WHEREAS, the Project Anchorage request for proposals did not originally include housing components but addressing the need for
    community housing continues to be a top priority for Girdwood; and

   WHEREAS, project developers, committee leaders and meeting participants have expressed a desire to incorporate community
    housing, where feasible, as a proposed use of the cabins; and

   WHEREAS, if the proposed sales tax is approved by voters in an areawide special election, a local process should complete the
     vetting process and prioritize projects based on funding, project stipulations and community priorities;

   THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors resolves support for the concept of the Girdwood Arts and Recreation proposal for
     consideration by the Anchorage Assembly.

   PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 4 to 0 this 16th day of December 2024.



     Jennifer Wingard                                        Margaret Tyler
   GBOS Land Use Supervisor                                   Attest
